# SciELO España

> SciELO España is an open-access scientific electronic library dedicated to publishing and discovering peer-reviewed Spanish health sciences research.

SciELO España is part of the larger SciELO network (Scientific Electronic Library Online), a collaborative initiative involving BIREME, FAPESP, and international health organizations like OPS/OMS. The platform serves as a digital repository for Spanish and Latin American scientific journals in health sciences, managed by the Instituto de Salud Carlos III.
